reason: I buy fabric when a sewing creator shows me something beautiful on Instagram or TikTok, and this is just a price list. Plain black viscose I can grab on Allegro from whoever I already order from, so there is no reason to switch.
objection: Nothing here makes me want it. It looks like every other fabric shop, and it's probably the same or cheaper on Allegro from someone else.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a sewing creator I follow make something gorgeous from their velour or viscose, with a link and a small discount code.
